summary: Iteration 4 — mobile/responsive pass. Tested mobile 390x844, tablet 768x1024, desktop 1920x800 for landing / and /carta. All functional mobile features work: hero wordmark full-width + short kicker + side-by-side CTAs above dish + Oli with bubble, nav hides scrolling down past 160px (--nav-offset:12px) and re-shows on scroll up (--nav-offset:84px) only on mobile (desktop nav always visible), cast horizontal snap carousel (6 members, scrollWidth=1524 > clientWidth=390, 'Desliza para conocerlos' hint shown), route-tracker centered at bottom (y=784, width=390, no overflow), carta filter-bar sticky, search input font-size=16px (no iOS zoom), filter-toggle opens bottom sheet filter-sheet with filter-sheet-handle/filter-sheet-reset/filter-sheet-apply, apply text updates live ('Ver 35 platos' -> 'Ver 9 platos' after cat-picar -> 'Ver 3 platos' after allergen gluten exclusion, back to 35 after reset), Mi mesa hidden when empty on mobile, full-width mesa-open-btn ('Ver mi mesa' + 6,50 €) after add, mesa-drawer opens as bottom sheet with proper pluralization '2 raciones' both in drawer and reserve-mesa-summary, reserve navigates to /#visita, dish-drawer opens as bottom sheet height<=92svh with dish-drawer-handle, ESC closes. Desktop regression: nav persists, mesa pill hidden on landing empty / visible always on carta bottom-right, filter inline panel (no filter-sheet rendered), dish drawer right-side, cast 6-col grid, 5 .outline-word elements. One minor issue found and FIXED: documentElement.scrollWidth was 400 (mobile) / 777 (tablet) due to html{overflow-x:visible}; added overflow-x:hidden to html in index.css — now 390/768/1920 clean.

test_results.mobile_route_tracker_above_mesa_bar_when: PASS (bottom-[84px] class active when count>0, inspected)
test_results.mobile_mesa_open_btn_full_width_after_ad: PASS (x=12 w=366 ~ full width minus insets, text 'Ver mi mesa' + total)

critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx useHideOnScroll: scroll handler reads window.innerWidth<768 inside handler — fine, but re-fires on every scroll event. Minor: could useMedia(MOBILE) to subscribe once. Non-blocking.

RouteTracker.jsx uses bottom-[84px] when count>0, bottom-4 otherwise, md:bottom-5 always — correct for mobile but on desktop (md:bottom-5) the 'count ? 84 : 4' is overridden; so mesa pill at bottom-5 right overlaps with route-tracker at md:bottom-5 center — both exist but at same y=5 they are x-separated (center vs right) so OK visually. Still worth centralising responsive classes.
Sheet.jsx: dragControls started on handle; backdrop click closes. For dish-drawer on mobile ESC also closes (good). bg-paper/text-coal looks ok on paper theme — contrast fine.

index.css: html overflow-x was visible while body overflow-x was hidden, causing documentElement.scrollWidth to leak 10px on mobile / 9px on tablet from a slightly rotated/translated child (likely rotated marquee strip). Added overflow-x:hidden to html — resolved. Preferred over hunting the exact source as the fix is one line and robust across future layouts.
FilterBar.jsx: input class 'text-base md:text-sm' ensures 16px on mobile — correct, matches iOS zoom-avoidance guidance.
Mesa.jsx: raciones(n) helper is exported from Mesa.jsx but importing module boundary across carta/visit remains stable; good single source of truth for pluralization used also in ReserveCard.
React Router v6 Future Flag warnings persist (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — pre-existing, non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (34/34 critical tests after one minor CSS fix)

seed_data_creation: localStorage key 'orilla-mesa' cleared before each run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsive is in good shape. One CSS fix applied in index.css: html { overflow-x: hidden; } to lock documentElement.scrollWidth to viewport width across 390/768/1920. All mobile-specific flows (nav hide, cast carousel, mobile mesa bar, bottom-sheet filter/dish/mesa, pluralization, route tracker shift above mesa bar) verified working against public URL. Hero at 1920 shows wordmark + dish side by side with wordmark overlapping dish image visually at the right edge (ends with letter A behind eggplant) — this is intentional per the design brief ('ORILLA' bleeds into dish photo on desktop). Dish drawer on mobile = bottom sheet (y+h ~= viewport h), on desktop = right-side panel (x+w ~= viewport w). filter-sheet-apply text is 'Ver N platos' and updates live as expected. 2 raciones vs 1 ración pluralization works in both mesa-drawer and reserve-mesa-summary.
